scenes.headline: How a decision model paints, one pixel at a time
scenes.sub: jev-paint, a robot loop and Jesse v1: Jev pointed at non-decisions.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Flint! Jev only makes typed decisions. This week, people pointed it at things that aren't decisions.

scenes.text: Ask one independent Choice per pixel and paint the answers. The picture comes from the marginals alone, and the brushwork maps where the model was unsure.
scenes.say: Ask one independent Choice per pixel, and paint the answers. The picture comes from the marginals alone, and the brushwork maps doubt.

steps.say: Jev-paint writes one block of state, the prompt and the grid. Then it asks one sixteen-colour Choice per pixel.
No question sees another. Thirty-two by thirty-two is a thousand and twenty-four questions, in eight requests.
Back come distributions. At twelve by twelve, their top picks already form a sunflower.

scenes.title: The brush rule, and its gate
scenes.say: The renderer turns each distribution into one number.

parts.note: H: entropy; e to the H is the effective number of colours
parts.say: Take its entropy, H. E to the H counts the colours effectively in play.

parts.note: low spread, a confident pixel, gets a wider brush
parts.say: Low spread, a confident pixel, gets a wider brush.
But below a spread of zero point four eight, no stroke is drawn. The widest brush never touches the canvas; texture marks doubt.

scenes.title: A robot arm, two questions per cycle

items.say: A robot run asks two questions per cycle: which of eight intents, like grasp or lift,
then which way to nudge each axis and the gripper. A shared executor does the actual motion.
The loop runs at zero point six two hertz, and eighty-seven point nine percent of that is waiting on the calls.

scenes.label: non-empty Jesse v1 patches that are byte-for-byte the SWE-bench gold patch
scenes.note: the other 495 are empty; on HumanEval it claims 100%
scenes.say: And Jesse v1, with no weights, claims a hundred percent on HumanEval. On SWE-bench, all five of its non-empty patches are the gold patches, byte for byte.

scenes.text: The number is almost never the finding; the shape of the question is.
scenes.say: In all three, the interface gets measured. The number is almost never the finding; the shape of the question is.

recap: Independent pixel Choices still paint a sunflower
The stroke gate makes texture a map of doubt
Round trips, not the model, slow the robot
scenes.say: To recap: independent Choices paint, the gate maps doubt, and round trips set the robot's pace.
